title: Fishtown Flavor trip: taste of Fishtowns bar & bites
blurb:
Discover the Culinary innovation of Philadelphia. On our exclusive food tour! Enjoy Modern takes of our favorites, from middle eastern to pizza, and cheese burgers. The great plus is that this tour can be enjoyed by all diets.

Walk pass our huge mural walls and quirky cafes as you sample an array of delights. From mouthwatering fusion street eats to hand-crafted desserts that are as Instagrammable as they are delicious, this tour is a journey for your taste buds. Immerse yourself in the vibrant culture, meet local owners, and savor the authentic flavors that define this trendy neighborhood. Book now and treat yourself to a food adventure that's anything but ordinary!
